summary: Cavedog's Total Annihilation is a landmark large-scale RTS, preserved through current Commander Pack storefront releases and community/fan-engine comparison routes.

entries.title: Total Annihilation

emulation.notes: Native Windows route with compatibility fixes as needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Commander Pack with exact fix/expansion/mod state documented

primary.version: Total Annihilation: Commander Pack on Steam/GOG
primary.why: The Commander Pack is the best current official route because it bundles the base game and expansion content for modern storefront access. Community patches, TA Escalation, and Spring-engine descendants should be labeled separately because they can alter behavior.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Steam or GOG Commander Pack. Record storefront/build, expansion/content scope, resolution/fix state, faction, mission/skirmish/map, unit cap, AI, multiplayer/LAN state, and any fan patch or Spring-derived route.

secondary.why: They are not the original executable route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record expansion/fix/mod state and multiplayer setup.
